items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: I think I played it about five years. With Gabriel. ... Well, that was when I was playing drum with Gabriel.

ctx.x: How old were you when you first got the drums? Eight years.

Eight years old? Eight years old. Eight years old, yeah. And I think I played it about five years. With Gabriel. With who? Give me his name. Gabriel, you know, he was a trumpet player. Old man, Manuel Gabriel. Yeah, I think that was his name, yeah. And I was so small, see, I couldn't tell him I'm going to play with him. See, I tell him, you come on home and ask mom, and if she says it's alright, that's alright with me because I like to play with a band, see. So he come home and got my mother's permission, and…
But, I wanted to ask you about the very first job you ever went out on, whether you made money or not.
